snippet.title: "The_Painther" - Showcase
snippet.description:
Itch.io game page link https://danka-dobric.itch.io/the-painther

Thanks for watching this showcase/trailer for my new game, The_Painther! Unfortunately, YouTube's compression doesn't do the video justice and a lot of the nice dithering details are lost. Keep in mind that the game looks much better when played! Once again, thanks for watching and checking out my game!
